Using \(S_m=0\):
\[
0=\frac{m}{2}(m+5-2m)=\frac{m(5-m)}{2},
\]
so \(m=5\). Then
\[
S_n=\frac{n}{2}(n-5),
\]
so
\[
nS_n=\frac{n^2(n-5)}{2}.
\]
Checking positive integers \(n\):
\[
n=1:-2,\quad n=2:-6,\quad n=3:-9,\quad n=4:-8,\quad n=5:0,\quad n\ge 6: \ge 18.
\]
The minimum is at \(n=3\).

\[
\boxed{-9}
\]
